diseases.name: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
diseases.clinical_notes: Rapidly progressive prion neurodegeneration with spongiform change, neuronal loss, and reactive gliosis. Typical sCJD course ~4–6 months. No published exhaled-VOC gold standard; priors analogized from acute oxidative neurodegeneration + necrosis literature (AD/PD/TBI panels).
